commands.allowedCommands.description: Executable and complete argument prefixes allowed without a prompt in Ask mode. Arguments match case-sensitively. Auto already grants command approval; matching deny rules always take precedence.
commands.deniedCommands.description: Executable and complete argument prefixes denied without asking for approval. Arguments match case-sensitively. Any matching deny rule takes precedence over allowed commands. Add * to deny all commands.
commands.commandExecutionTimeout.descrip: Maximum time in seconds to wait for command execution to complete before timing out (0 = no timeout, 1-600s, default: 0s)
commands.commandTimeoutAllowlist.descrip: Executable and complete argument prefixes exempt from the configured command execution timeout. Every command in a chain must match. Agent-requested timeouts still apply.
Prevent task completion when there are incomplete todos in the todo list
settings.completionHooks.description: Optional lifecycle command hooks: sessionStart, subagentStart, userPromptSubmit, preToolUse, postToolUse, permissionRequest, preCompact, postCompact, interrupt, sessionEnd, stop, and subagentStop. Each command has an absolute executable path, optional args, and optional timeoutMs (100–30000). Commands receive event context as JSON on stdin. Shutdown hooks share a 3-second deadline; interruption gets at most 1 second. Hooks run without a shell and cannot grant tool permissions. Configure in user settings.
settings.vsCodeLmModelSelector.descripti: Settings for VSCode Language Model API
settings.vsCodeLmModelSelector.vendor.de: The vendor of the language model (e.g. copilot)
settings.vsCodeLmModelSelector.family.de: The family of the language model (e.g. gpt-4)
settings.vsCodeLmModelSelector.version.d: The version of the language model
settings.vsCodeLmModelSelector.id.descri: The unique identifier of the language model
settings.customStoragePath.description: Custom storage path. Leave empty to use the default location. Supports absolute paths (e.g. 'D:\AlphaStorage')
settings.autoImportSettingsPath.descript: Path to a Alpha configuration file to automatically import on extension startup. Supports absolute paths and paths relative to the home directory (e.g. '~/Documents/alpha-settings.json'). Leave empty to disable auto-import.
settings.maximumIndexedFilesForFileSearc: Maximum number of files to index for the @ file search feature. Higher values provide better search results in large projects but may use more memory. Default: 10,000.
settings.useAgentRules.description: Enable loading of AGENTS.md files for agent-specific rules (see https://agent-rules.org/)
settings.projectRootMarkers.description: User-owned filenames or directories that mark the nearest project instruction and portable skill boundary. Defaults to .git. An empty list restricts discovery to the task folder; workspace settings cannot override it.
settings.projectDocFallbackFilenames.des: User-owned instruction filenames to try after AGENTS.override.md and AGENTS.md, before the legacy AGENT.md fallback. Entries must be basenames; workspace settings cannot override this list.
settings.apiRequestTimeout.description: Maximum seconds without provider response activity (0 disables this inactivity timeout, default: 600s). Progressing responses can continue beyond this window. Explicit caller and context deadlines still apply.
settings.newTaskRequireTodos.description: Require todos parameter when creating new tasks with the new_task tool
settings.codeIndex.embeddingBatchSize.de: The batch size for embedding operations during code indexing. Adjust this based on your API provider's limits. Default is 60.
settings.debug.description: Enable debug mode to show the incident dashboard and additional buttons for viewing API conversation history and UI messages as prettified JSON in temporary files.
settings.debugProxy.enabled.description: **Enable Debug Proxy** — Route all outbound network requests through a proxy for MITM debugging. Only active when running in debug mode (F5).
settings.debugProxy.serverUrl.descriptio: Proxy URL (e.g., `http://127.0.0.1:8888`). Only used when **Debug Proxy** is enabled.
settings.debugProxy.tlsInsecure.descript: Legacy setting. TLS certificate verification remains enabled for debug proxies.
settings.debugProxy.tlsInsecure.deprecat: debugProxy.tlsInsecure is deprecated. TLS verification remains enabled; trust the proxy CA before launching the development host.
